aggregation_rules: All fields are computed per exact ClaimKey. raw_counts includes every preserved Reading once, including unverified, unexpected-seat, duplicate-seat and withdrawn readings. raw_dissent_reading_ids includes every OPPOSE/DISPUTE Reading, with ineligible_dissent_reading_ids the ineligible subset. No vote or eligibility count can delete them. Each stance count is a record count, never an independence probability.

ReadingDisposition observation eligibility priority: duplicate-seat group first -> INELIGIBLE_DUPLICATE_SEAT; unexpected seat next -> INELIGIBLE_NOT_EXPECTED_SEAT; coherent manual withdrawal next -> INELIGIBLE_WITHDRAWN; external/unverified next -> INELIGIBLE_UNVERIFIED; otherwise ELIGIBLE_MANUAL_FIXTURE_ONLY. Retain all applicable reason codes, not only the priority status. All syntactically valid but ineligible dissent remains visible. malformed or missing bound records refuse the replay, rather than manufacturing an ineligible accepted observation.

Claim structural qualification is computed independently of observation eligibility: matched full declaration -> QUALIFIED_STRUCTURE_ONLY; structural mismatch -> UNQUALIFIED_MISMATCH; opaque profile -> UNQUALIFIED_UNSUPPORTED; insufficient scope -> UNQUALIFIED_INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE. No response structure or factual correctness is checked. eligible_counts counts only eligible manual records. structurally_qualified_counts additionally requires QUALIFIED_STRUCTURE_ONLY. Thus agreeing opaque or mismatched readings may have eligible stance agreement but no structurally qualified agreement.

present_seat_ids is expected Seat IDs with any preserved Reading for that exact Claim, regardless of eligibility, withdrawal or abstention. missing_seat_ids is expected minus present; unexpected arrivals do not change it. abstaining_reading_ids contains all raw ABSTAIN records. qualified_dissent_reading_ids contains eligible structurally-qualified OPPOSE/DISPUTE records. conflicting_duplicate_reading_ids contains every member of each duplicate Seat/Claim group. withdrawal_ids and challenge_ids list every related record, not just eligible ones.

For each eligible or structurally qualified decisive set independently: exclude ABSTAIN; no decisive record -> NO_DECISIVE_READINGS; exactly one -> SINGLE_DECISIVE_READING; at least two with identical stance -> RECORDED_AGREEMENT; otherwise RECORDED_DISAGREEMENT. DISPUTE is a decisive stance and remains dissent even if multiple DISPUTE records agree. OPPOSE agreement is not support. These labels neither suppress challenges nor imply a majority, family threshold, semantic truth or completeness. threshold_verdict is always NOT_DEFINED. observation_class distinguishes manual-only, external-only, mixed or no raw readings.

bounds.bound_intersection: All earlier process/time/memory/output/native/container limits remain binding. Individual maxima are not simultaneously guaranteed to fit. Exact refusal replaces truncation. Schema/rules files and external evidence are not silently added to the source set; if packaged, each consumes ordinary source/archive/count budgets.

change_history_rules: Dependency direction is dependent Claim -> required SourceKey/ClaimKey. Validate existence, exact identity and acyclicity before accepted replay. Source nodes are terminal; claim graph cycles refuse REFUSED_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE. Missing any declared target, selector source, provenance/blob/input record or required predecessor refuses REFUSED_MISSING_DEPENDENCY. Preserve bounded missing keys/reasons and old immutable artifacts; no source fetching, invented edge or success prefix.

UpdateNotice.old_version and logical_source_id must agree. REPLACEMENT requires a nonnull new_version of the same logical source ID, different exact version, and correction_text=null. WITHDRAWAL requires new_version=null and correction_text=null. ATTRIBUTED_CORRECTION requires nonnull correction_text, with new_version either null or a distinct same-logical-ID supplied version. Both old and nonnull new versions must exist by exact SourceKey. An issuer_claim_id is only an attributed string, never authenticated identity or entitlement.

Every nonnull predecessor_event_id resolves to a supplied exact UpdateNotice and held external record pin of the same logical source. It declares informational event precedence only: no source-version continuity, valid sequential amendment or currentness. Missing predecessor -> REFUSED_MISSING_DEPENDENCY/MISSING_PREDECESSOR; self/multi-cycle -> REFUSED_UPDATE_PREDECESSOR_CYCLE, separately from claim DAGs. Check all supplied events. Batch duplicate event IDs -> REFUSED_DUPLICATE_EVENT_ID; held ID with different canonical bytes -> REFUSED_INPUT_INTEGRITY. Arrival order and clocks choose nothing.
count_rules: Depth counts root container as1, and each nested object/array adds1; scalars add0. Enforce max12 for all metadata inputs, supported structured originals and deterministic outputs. Exact parser allocation strategy remains unimplemented/unproved.

all_record_objects counts one body registry, every body registry Seat, every body RuleSpec, one body Policy, every element in each other body record array, plus each embedded InputManifest.registry_snapshot and every Seat in that copy. Body object, key/pin objects, statements/guards/nodes and result objects are not record objects for this count; they remain byte/depth/individual caps. Equal inline copies consume bytes and record budget each time.

Every literal text field is at most4096 UTF-8 bytes. Every attribution/reason/detail/uncertainty/omitted-scope/provenance/model/provider/run/time/limitation text field is at most1024 UTF-8 bytes, including descriptions in external records. Schema fields with a smaller bound retain it. Strings in exclusion arrays each at most1024 bytes. All ID fields are ASCII and at most32 bytes. Blob base64 is a wire encoding, bounded by decoded4096 bytes plus canonical text and global body caps.

The ordinary container's Q_RECORDS source is not listed in body.sources and cannot be selected or used as a source, dependency, identity evidence or manifest input. Its complete bytes/count still consume the ordinary container budgets. Thus body original SourceVersion records plus Q_RECORDS and any other ordinary container sources together must fit16 sources and65536 bytes. Unique source-version keys are dependency source nodes; SourceVersion alias IDs do not create additional nodes. Claims are unique id/revision nodes. No graph node inferred from prose.

Top-level IDs across registry, body Seats, Policy and every element of every body array are globally unique, except distinct Claim revisions may share Claim.id only with distinct revision labels; their addressable pin ID is claim_id + ':' + revision, which must itself fit Id and must not collide. Registry snapshots inside manifests are deliberate exact repeated copies and are not new addressable IDs. Source logical IDs may identify distinct versions, while SourceVersion.id remains unique. No ambiguous string concatenation is used for SourceKeys; compare complete objects.

record_pins contains exactly one pin for every addressable body record, including body registry Seats and canonical Claim records under their derived pin IDs, and no unrelated IDs. input_manifest_pins repeats exactly the subset for InputManifest records. Duplicate copies of identical pins cannot silently disappear: uniqueItems and exact required-set checks apply. Every source referenced by Body records must be supplied within the admitted ordinary-source set. Externally pinned schema/protocol/checker/runtime/decoder descriptors are separately supplied bootstrap inputs; if also packaged, ordinary source/count caps apply. Do not fetch missing targets.
identity_rules: External ReplayRequest is independently held outside Q_RECORDS. It binds complete enclosing package digest/length, Q_RECORDS bytes, exact Task/registry/rules/Policy, all body records, schema/protocol/checker/runtime/import-closure identities and source keys. Body never contains its own digest or enclosing package identity. Registry contains no registry digest. Task has no task/snapshot digest field. Registry pin appears only outside the registry; this proposal puts it only in ReplayRequest.

InputManifest is a separately canonical record containing exactly pre-assessment Task, Claim, source versions, selector/dependency pins, static registry snapshot, rule/policy pins and prompt/settings pins. It contains no Reading, response, RunEvidence, Provenance, Challenge, withdrawal, update, history, ReplayResult, receipt or final-package pin, directly or transitively through a content-digest edge. Reading binds InputManifest by exact canonical pin. Several readings of identical inputs may share one manifest. All duplicate registry bytes and setup work remain charged.

Manifest.registry_snapshot must be complete exact structural and canonical-byte equality to body.registry. Its Seats are static declared identities. Seat.identity_evidence, when present, is a supplied original SourceKey and a bounded assertion; it cannot reference a body record, Q_RECORDS, run, response, provenance, result, receipt or evidence that depends on later run artifacts. Cycles through opaque original contents cannot be inferred semantically; provenance policy remains unverified rather than asserting independence.

Canonical Claim bytes bind task_view_id and dependency/selector IDs, not the Task or dependency digests. Task.claim_rosters pins exact Claim keys. Dependency.dependent uses ClaimLabel; dependency target CLAIM uses full ClaimKey. This directed digest graph is acyclic. Validate exact content identity before relying on IDs; no fixed-point hashing or digest-field omission convention is permitted.

UpdateNotice.predecessor_event_id and ReadingWithdrawal.predecessor_withdrawal_id are symbolic immutable IDs. External record_pins binds each event's complete canonical digest/length, avoiding an event that embeds its own digest through a causal cycle. Every nonnull predecessor must resolve to the correct exact supplied record and held external pin. ID graph cycles can be rejected on genuine finite canonical fixtures without impossible circular content hashes. Their DAGs are separately checked from claim dependencies.

For every digest-bearing reference, construct its dependency relation from the closed typed fields and verify it has no self or multi-object content-identity cycle. IDs alone are not content-digest edges. A missing external pin or wrong digest/length refuses; never fill pins from the candidate as a trusted substitute. ReplayEnvelope wraps a separately canonical ReplayRequest plus optional untrusted_receipt. Result.request binds only ReplayRequest, whose fields exclude imported receipts and all results. The untrusted outer receipt can therefore refer to prior result bytes without a digest cycle; it never enters recomputation. Request itself is held externally, never embedded in Body.

CheckerIdentity keys pin small separately supplied identity-descriptor bytes, never runtime/bootstrap/native-binary bytes. Each descriptor is at most65536 bytes and must bind the entire existing externally supplied bootstrap/import/runtime/decoder install identity under its independently checked existing manifest format. No arbitrary16-file import inventory is implied. Actual binary/file counts and sizes retain their already qualified external installation bounds; no package/source/archive cap is raised. Missing or unverified descriptor closure blocks replay. The proposal neither provides a fake verification attestation nor admits a new installer.

Admitted record versions are exactly V1 for Body Registry, Policy, TaskView and RuleSpecs, including inline registry copies. Body.rules has exactly one of each SOURCE_MEMBERSHIP_V1, Q_DECLARATION_IDENTITY_V1, DECLARED_DEPENDENCY_IMPACT_V1 and RECORDED_STANCE_COUNTS_V1. Task.registry_id=Body.registry.id; Task.policy_id=Body.policy.id; Task.rule_ids is exactly Body.rules IDs once each. Every Manifest.rule_specs is the exact full canonical pin set of Body.rules; Manifest.policy is the exact Body.policy pin; Manifest.registry_snapshot equals Body.registry. ReplayRequest rules/policy/registry pins bind those same complete records. Missing, extra, substituted or inconsistent reference sets refuse REFUSED_REFERENCE_INCONSISTENCY before recomputation; admission failures use REFUSED_UNADMITTED_REPLAY as ordered above.
impact_rules: Every fully bound informational update notice seeds old_version for conservative review; it remains INFORMATIONAL_QUARANTINED and cannot choose a new current source, make withdrawal effective, mark a claim false or change original bytes. Least reverse-reachable declared dependents are NEEDS_REVALIDATION. Unreachable claims are UNCHANGED_DECLARED_CLOSURE, which says nothing about undeclared dependencies or semantic completeness. Every affected claim reports all trigger update IDs and exact dependency paths.

Path output is bounded: enumerate distinct simple dependency paths with lexicographically sorted dependency-ID vectors; each path at most32 edges, each claim at most64 paths, with complete output cap binding. If all required paths cannot fit, refuse REFUSED_COMPLETE_OUTPUT_BOUND; never trim. Reachability requires at most32 monotone discovery rounds over at most32 source/claim nodes and64 edges; this is a proposed finite algorithm bound, not a proof or executed implementation.

Define effect=(kind,new_version,correction_text), compared by complete structural equality, with no natural-language equivalence inference. Distinct notices conflict when effects differ and either exact old_version keys agree (regardless of predecessors), or they share a nonnull predecessor_event_id and logical_source_id. Preserve every notice; list all conflicting IDs and mark their reverse-dependent Claims declared_preconditions=CONFLICT. Different IDs, provenance or issuer attribution alone do not make identical effects conflict. Otherwise complete declared context yields MATCH. MISSING occurs only in nonaccepted diagnostics. change_impact remains separate, never truth or winner selection.

HistoryEntry artifacts remain exact immutable original SourceKeys under ordinary bounds, with classifications preserved verbatim; they cannot be embedded as authoritative verdicts. A PRIOR_COMMITTED_UPDATE entry must reference a canonical UpdateNotice original whose ID and body equal the supplied event. Only then report that ID already_recorded_update_ids. Report every input history ID retained. already-recorded notices remain replay inputs and do not mutate history. Independent events commute as sets; sort output ID sets lexicographically. There is no accepted stateful commit, refresh, automatic revalidation clearing, archival truncation or current-snapshot switch in this proposal.
manual_fixture_recipe: Freeze one canonical DeclarationSource or opaque original, actual original bytes and full SourceKey. Create SourceVersion, Selector, Claim and explicit SOURCE/REF Dependencies.

Create manual Seat with null model ID and MANUAL_FIXTURE_ONLY, static Registry, four admitted Rules/Policy, prompt/settings/raw-response Blobs and manually authored Provenance with run_evidence_id=null. No model run is implied.

Pin canonical Claim; create Task with explicit expected seats and no selfdigest. Create Manifest with exact Task/Claim/source/selector/dependency/rule/policy/prompt/settings pins and complete Registry snapshot. Pin Manifest, then create Reading bound to it and raw-response/provenance. Manifest excludes Reading/response/provenance.

Create Body with explicit empty absent categories. Compute held record, Body/package/schema/protocol/checker pins only after bytes are fixed. Keep ReplayRequest/Envelope outside Body. Freeze independently authored literal controls; schema shape evidence is not checker qualification.
output_rules: Deterministic result has no elapsed time, run timestamp, process identifier, random nonce or own digest. Every set-valued ID/pin/key array is sorted by canonical UTF-8 bytes; preserve semantic operand/node order and dependency path order. Input record arrays are likewise sorted by canonical addressable ID (Claims by id then revision); inputs out of this order refuse noncanonical. Record arrays are not reordered to salvage a pin mismatch.

accepted_result=true means complete bound informational recomputation only. Keep source_authentication=UNVERIFIED, current_authority=NONE, freshness=UNKNOWN, semantic_completeness=UNPROVEN and claim_truth=NOT_ASSESSED. No current authorization, universal interpretation or ACCEPTED_V1.

All failures emit Refusal with accepted_result=false and dimension_status=NOT_EVALUATED; uncomputed dimensions are never unchanged closure, no-assessor observation or false. diagnostic_result must be null except REFUSED_IMPORTED_RECEIPT after complete local recomputation; then a DiagnosticResult has accepted_result=false and explicitly diagnostic computed claims. It never contains a nested accepted ReplayResult. Missing source/predecessor keys and reason detail are bounded; overflow uses one fixed bounded refusal reason rather than truncating an accepted result. Fixed no-partial-dimensions gate ordering is an explicit prefreeze amendment: historical D08/D14/D35/D39 partial observations remain preserved in older drafts, not recomputed here; no silent oracle rewrite.

ReplayEnvelope.untrusted_receipt is the sole allowed imported claimed_verdict location, ignored by every recomputation. A verdict in body/core records refuses closed schema. If validate_import=false, no result equality claim is made. If true, received_result_source, exact held digest/length (carried imported results are capped at65536 bytes by SourceKey; larger results refuse this carried-import lane) and supplied bytes must agree, and complete canonical received result must equal the newly recomputed canonical ReplayResult bytes; any mismatch -> REFUSED_IMPORTED_RECEIPT with nonaccepted local diagnostics. Imported identity fields cannot supply missing trusted envelope pins. Claimed_verdict is never a decision input.

Pure replay has no commit/recovery operation. Stateful interruption/commit codes exist only as refused diagnostic envelopes for inherited controls and cannot claim a successful commit. Before any future stateful operation, freeze and qualify separate custody/atomicity/recovery policy. Existing source-bound native proof/runtime/recovery/interoperability gates remain unrun here.
reading_provenance_rules: Manual Seat must have declared_model_id=null, identity_assurance=MANUAL_FIXTURE_ONLY and origin_kind=MANUAL_DEVELOPMENT_FIXTURE. Proposed named-model labels may appear only as labels, never originating-run attribution. Manual Reading/Provenance origin must match; provenance.method=MANUALLY_AUTHORED_ILLUSTRATION and run_evidence_id=null. Manual fixtures can be eligible only as manual demonstrations. Family labels are declared fixture categories; counts do not prove independent errors or actual provider families.

External Seat has identity_assurance=UNVERIFIED. External Reading requires matching external Provenance with method=RECORDED_UNVERIFIED_EXTERNAL_RUN and a supplied RunEvidence. Missing declared records refuse; absent optional evidence remains explicit null. RunEvidence fields are declared claims, verification=UNVERIFIED, independent_inputs=UNKNOWN. Any named-model/family/run eligibility remains INELIGIBLE_UNVERIFIED in this schema version, even if a policy SourceKey is supplied. Separately held policy/run evidence, an admitted policy and qualification are required before changing this gate; this data proposal does not make that change.

Reading seat/task/ClaimKey/source_versions/input_manifest/prompt/settings must match the exact selected manifest and static Seat; reading origin must agree with Seat/Provenance. Prompt/settings refs resolve to Blob of matching kind. response resolves to RAW_RESPONSE Blob and provenance pin to Provenance. Manifest prompt/settings kinds are exact; RunEvidence response/prompt/settings/input manifest must match Reading. A Provenance.evidence pin resolves only PROVENANCE_EVIDENCE Blob; analogous Challenge, Withdrawal and Update evidence pins resolve their respective Blob kinds. Task.task_text resolves TASK_TEXT Blob. No optional evidence reference silently resolves to a missing object.

Every Reading.response is the preserved raw first output bytes, with exact length/digest in Blob and held record pins. Readings declare stance as supplied data; no model or semantic parser derives stance. Altering raw response under old pins refuses input integrity. Multiple Reading records for same Seat/Claim revision remain in raw history; all such records are duplicate-seat inputs and none counts as additional eligible support, even byte-identical records. Duplicate record IDs refuse rather than being deduplicated.

Challenge is immutable UNRESOLVED_INFORMATIONAL. Its Claim key must resolve; optional reading/seat IDs, when nonnull, must resolve and match that Claim/Seat. All challenges for a Claim appear in aggregation regardless of eligibility or whether a Reading lists them. Reading.challenge_ids must resolve to challenges for its own Claim and either its own Reading or null; unlisted Claim challenges are still reported. No automatic resolution or disappearance after majority support.

ReadingWithdrawal preserves the target Reading, reason, provenance, evidence and optional withdrawal predecessor. Only a coherent manual-fixture request with manually authored provenance and author_claim equal to the target Reading provenance's author_claim excludes a manual reading from manual illustrative counts. That string equality is a fixture rule, never authentication. External/unverified requests remain visible but do not grant authority or erase evidence. All withdrawals are retained in outputs. Null predecessor is a root request; nonnull predecessor must name a withdrawal for the same reading. Reject withdrawal self/multi-cycles as REFUSED_REFERENCE_INCONSISTENCY; no stateful revocation or clearing policy is admitted.
record_rules: SourceVersion.id is a record alias; SourceVersion.key is normative source identity. Same logical_source_id may have several exact versions; no version label/timestamp chooses currency. Every source length/digest is recomputed against exact ordinary-container original bytes. DEF_OLD/DEF_NEW fixture aliases must expand to distinct complete versions of logical_source_id SECTION_B; their precise REF/dependency keys must agree.

Selector uses half-open byte [begin,end). Require0<=begin<=end<=source.bytes. Reject empty slices of nonempty originals. Only an empty original may use [0,0), yielding EMPTY_SOURCE_MATCH_NONPROBATIVE. Compare decoded quote to exact slice; a well-bound unequal quote yields DIFFERS, not a truth judgment. Whole-source or quote digest/length mismatch is integrity refusal. Selectors never establish entailment, relevance or authority.

Claim declares exactly OPAQUE_PROSE_V1 or Q_DECLARATION_IDENTITY_V1. The former preserves bounded text, uncertainty and omitted scope with UNRESOLVED_UNSUPPORTED_PROFILE. The latter compares only Claim.payload.statement against the entire canonical DeclarationSource.statement selected by exactly one full-source selector; any selector shape/scope not covering that whole designated source yields UNRESOLVED_INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE. More than one designated full-source selector is not silently selected; require exactly one selector for the structural profile or refuse reference inconsistency. No response parsing supplies the compared declaration. Structural comparison additionally requires that selector source-membership status MATCH; DIFFERS yields NOT_CHECKED_MISSING_EVIDENCE. Any NOT_CHECKED interpretation leaves claim_structural_qualification=NOT_EVALUATED.

A Guard has1..32 nodes indexed from0. root must be last index and every node must be reachable from root. NOT operand and AND/OR left/right must be strictly earlier indices. Preserve operand ordering and repeated operands. TRUE/FALSE and REF are opaque syntax; no Boolean simplification, evaluation, English extraction or equivalence checking occurs. Every REF target SourceKey must have an explicit Claim Dependency with identical key and relevant role; missing declaration refuses REFUSED_REFERENCE_INCONSISTENCY, missing declared target refuses REFUSED_MISSING_DEPENDENCY. REF interpretation beyond exact target identity stays UNPROVEN.

Statement equality is exact complete five-field structural identity, including ordered guard node arrays and exact full SourceKeys. Differences in subject/action/modality/condition/exception yield DIFFERS_DECLARATION_STRUCTURE_ONLY. Exact equality yields MATCHED_DECLARATION_STRUCTURE_ONLY. Neither means natural-language entailment, truth or completeness. Source declaration bytes must be canonical, with no added fields, extensions, normalization or keyword parser.

Claim selector/dependency IDs resolve exactly; each Dependency.dependent equals its sole owning ClaimLabel and appears once in that Claim. Task.context_dependency_ids is a supplied dependency subset. The sole Task covers every supplied Claim exactly once in claim_rosters; all Claims name it and expected Seats belong to Registry. Empty expected roster is explicit, never inferred. Task.selected_sources is its exact admitted source set, containing every selector/REF/dependency/manifest-required version. Each Selector source needs an explicit owning-Claim SOURCE Dependency with identical SourceKey; absent edge refuses REFUSED_REFERENCE_INCONSISTENCY, never inferred.
remaining_blockers: Owner adoption, independent actual-GPT-6.1 re-review, literal identity/canonical vectors and independent adversarial oracle remain unresolved; no freeze.
Inherited source-bound proof, warnings/static analysis, installed runtime, recovery, independent interoperability, matched baseline/uncertainty and external-human qualification remain unrun here.
Participant access, original cap start/used hours and monetary/resource feasibility unresolved. No cap reset or new feature/trial/live-assessor/outreach admission.
Natural-language entailment, truth, undeclared dependencies, independent model inputs and authority remain UNPROVEN/UNKNOWN or outside the structural profile.
base_protocol_rules.scope: Revision02 pure-replay draft; preserve prior artifacts/gates. No execution, outreach, dependency or acceptance admission. Independent literal controls/re-review required.
validation_order: PREPARSE: hard byte budget; strict UTF-8, Unicode scalar values, integer lexical tokens, duplicate-key detection and nesting cap before unbounded allocation.
BOUNDS: every local and aggregate count/byte/resource cap; no silent trimming or partial success.

ADMISSION/SCHEMA: before shape validation refuse unknown top-level schema, Registry/Policy/TaskView/RuleSpec version other than V1, unknown rule kind, or Body.rules not exactly one of each admitted kind with REFUSED_UNADMITTED_REPLAY. Then pinned local Draft2020-12 schema: unknown/missing/extra properties or unsupported payload profiles refuse REFUSED_CLOSED_SCHEMA. All fields required; null only where declared.
IDENTITY: canonical bytes and every externally held pin; original/quotation/blob length and digest; input-manifest exclusion rules and acyclic digest dependency graph.
REFERENCES: IDs, exact SourceKeys/ClaimKeys, expected seats, kind constraints, full dependency closure, exact registry copies and preassessment manifests.
GRAPHS: separate source/claim dependency DAG, update predecessor DAG and reading-withdrawal predecessor DAG; check all nodes/edges before recomputation.
RECOMPUTATION: selector membership, optional claim-level structure equality, independent aggregation fields and declared change-impact closure; no model call or source fetching.
IMPORT_COMPARISON: only if explicitly requested, compare held imported result bytes against complete recomputed canonical result bytes.
OUTPUT_BOUND: materialize no accepted publication until complete canonical output including its single process LF fits. Pure replay mutates no history or prior snapshot.

wire_rules.rule: Metadata is strict UTF-8 without BOM; reject invalid UTF-8 and unpaired surrogates including escaped surrogate code points. Sources are opaque bytes and may be invalid UTF-8. Only a selected Q_DECLARATION_IDENTITY_V1 original is parsed as strict canonical DeclarationSource JSON; other original bytes remain opaque. Never normalize Unicode/newlines/case/whitespace or interpret source instructions as executable instructions.

Canonical JSON has sorted object keys by Unicode scalar sequence, comma and colon separators, no insignificant whitespace, ensure_ascii=false, no final LF and no floats. Strings emit literal Unicode scalar UTF-8 except quote and backslash escaped with backslash, U+0008 as backslash-b, U+0009 as backslash-t, U+000A as backslash-n, U+000C as backslash-f, U+000D as backslash-r, other U+0000..U+001F as lowercase four-hex backslash-u escape. Solidus and U+2028/U+2029 remain literal. All metadata numbers are lexical 0 or positive decimal without leading zero; reject negative numbers including -0, decimal points, exponent syntax, NaN and infinity. Boolean tokens are only allowed at schema boolean/constant-boolean positions. Schema integer alone cannot reject 0.0; enforce lexical form before schema. No duplicate object keys at any nesting level.

SHA-256 is lowercase full hexadecimal over exact bytes. Pin bytes are canonical bytes of the referenced complete record or exact original/blob bytes as explicitly typed. Pin has no implied URI and never fetches. A record has no own digest/length field unless it describes different opaque bytes, such as Blob or SourceVersion.key. SourceKey is exactly logical_source_id, sha256, bytes; every REF, Selector, dependency, task and update uses this same key with exact field equality. ClaimKey is claim_id, revision, canonical-Claim sha256 and canonical-Claim bytes. ClaimLabel names id/revision, resolved through the unique supplied canonical Claim and external pin. Hash assumptions and held pins do not authenticate authors.

Base64 is canonical padded RFC4648 alphabet, no whitespace, no alternate alphabet and zero unused pad bits; decode then re-encode must give identical text. Schema pattern cannot prove pad bits or byte length. Blob.bytes and sha256 bind decoded bytes; each blob is at most4096 decoded bytes. quote_bytes and quote_sha256 bind decoded exact quote bytes at most4096. STRICT_UTF8 blobs must decode to scalar UTF-8; CANONICAL_JSON blobs must satisfy W01/W02 and depth/bound rules; their uninterpreted data never grants authority.

Use only pinned local schema definitions. The $schema identifier declares the existing standard, not permission to fetch it. Runtime resolution of any network $ref is forbidden; every operational $ref in this proposal is local #/$defs. A validator PASS alone is shape evidence, never valid replay or protocol acceptance. String maxLength limits characters; separately apply UTF-8 byte limits. Object uniqueness, cross-field equality, sums, graph laws, canonical tokens and digests require independent protocol checks.

arms.comparison: ClaimResult arrays compare exact canonical bytes: no arm field exists there. Compare entire ReplayResult after removing ONLY top-level request field; no recursive field-name exclusion or other normalization. Exact recovered main alias/bytes/Body and derived canonical source index also equal. Original vs transport request pins differ solely because actual package identities differ; all annotations/checker setup charged in both arms.
arms.original: Request.package pins exact canonical original-source-envelope.json bytes. Envelope closes actual ordinary source index, no ZIP/base64 copying/preparation. Actual originals separately held/pinned/supplied; verify every index entry length/hash against real bytes. Index itself is external setup metadata, not ordinary source.
arms.transport: Request.package pins exact meaning.zip bytes. Qualified held handoff manifest separately binds share.txt, archive and expected STS1 identity; existing receiver performs decoder identity, archive/content regeneration and exact source recovery. No unverified metadata-only transport shortcut.

auxiliary_cycle_amendment.correctness: That demands a content identity fixed point. Preserve prior draft as failed design; auxiliary bytes now lie outside Request closure. There is no omitted selfdigest or equality shortcut.
auxiliary_cycle_amendment.old_rule: Prior draft allowed imported-result bytes in Request-bound ordinary source/package closure, while demanding equality with result bound to that same Request.
auxiliary_cycle_amendment.risk: Auxiliary metadata is untrusted; exact held pin and outer receipt only establish supplied byte consistency, never independent custody, source authentication, currentness, model identity, or authority. Main+auxiliary resource charging remains unchanged.

digest_field_inventory.target: actual Python executable and two profile library leaves
native bin and fixed MODULES tool files
exact six existing helper paths plus transport test helper
actual share/archive or original source file bytes
actual complete file leaves plus mode

full_phase_order.rule: Fixed root order: held Request raw, Envelope raw, Body raw, original index if original arm, auxiliary receipt raw only at IMPORT_COMPARISON. Strict bounded raw UTF8/integer-token/duplicate/scalar/depth reader; no arbitrary dictionary root or caller trust flag. Native archive decoding/qualified bootstrap occurs outside this pure phase.

Apply unchanged document/local/aggregate caps, physical main+aux count/bytes, host tuple builtin types and bounded scalar shapes, package alias finite profile, before candidate traversal/allocation. Existing decoder/installer caps remain separate.

Closed admitted roots/versions/kinds first; exact four Rule kinds once and versions V1. Unsupported admission REFUSED_UNADMITTED_REPLAY before later candidate Request runtime mismatch. No runtime $ref fetching.

Execute identity-subphases.json exact ordered ledger, including full matching DeclarationSource raw/canonical/closed-schema read-ahead and exact source REF targets. Every coarse pin resolves actual record/source type and exact canonical bytes before assigning rank; no semantic Blob.kind/set/role inference here.

Execute references ledger: semantic typed kinds, all full static/dynamic closure, positional REF roles, held event predecessor presence, History.related_record_ids to actual addressable derived pin IDs in original listed order. All records validated even unused. No latent dangling closure accepted.

Body Claim guards by Claim pair, condition then exception; parsed source guards by complete SourceKey C, condition then exception; Claim dependency DAG; Update predecessor DAG; Withdrawal predecessor DAG; selected source REF DAG; then fixed record/descriptor ranks. Each earlier complete class checked before next; no missing predecessor promoted to root. Separate cycle refusals; do not expand existing <=8 Update helper to withdrawals<=32.

Reuse actual owned parsed source statement and complete validated record bundles, never reparse or synthesize Claim eligibility from flags. Compare exact five fields/guard node order and compute complete selector/impact/history/Reading aggregation under frozen earlier contracts. No partial accepted dimensions.

Only outer auxiliary bytes are compared. First verify auxiliary held pin/receipt source+digest+length and alias/content separation (the latter already BOUNDS/IDENTITY), then if validate_import=true parse strict canonical ReplayResult and compare exact bytes with independently recomputed local full result. Claimed verdict ignored. Different Request pin yields mismatch; no normalization of imported full result. False means no imported-verdict/equality claim.
